turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk through the version history.
Walk me through it, then. I'm writing down what you say, so be specific: what do you have, and who has seen it besides you?
612 words in one edit at 11:52 PM, then 794 more at 11:58 PM.
Okay. I'm writing down 11:52 and 11:58 PM. What date was that, and where did this history come from?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written promise that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record.
What moved her: You gave exact times and word counts from the version history, which got her to ask real questions instead of attacking, though without a date it wasn't enough to shift her position.
What cost ground: You went straight to the evidence without owning that the zero was entered before anyone called her, so her main grievance stayed untouched.
Try next time: Right after her first line about the phone, say in one sentence that the zero went in before you called and that was wrong, then bring out the version history with its date and where it came from.
Redo the debrief as a table please.
